classification: CHECKER COVERAGE BUG; additive correction, not a claim that the proposed profile is infeasible
cause: Two new primal checkers used m=(m-1)&m with the evolving m instead of a fixed original mask, so they followed only a descending chain instead of all subsets.
receipt_scope_withdrawn: frontier-20261029-plane-functional-primal-gap-test1-check.json asserted all full rows but checked only 8434. Do not use that receipt as full primal coverage.
unexecuted_affected_checker: The affine-tail primal checker v1 had not produced any receipt; do not use it.
new_protection: Fixed-mask subset enumeration asserts 2^popcount coverage; the functional checker separately checks its full expected row count. Replays use new outputs; all old bytes remain unchanged.
unaffected: The normalized-primal producer itself checked every full model row, and the pre-existing independent dual checkers do coefficient identities rather than this subset enumeration. Compressed/nested generators and their full-row census helpers already used fixed masks and are unaffected.
